about_the_game:
If you’ve been enjoying Cozy Littlequarium and want to support the development of the game (and future updates), this Supporter Pack is perfect for you! 💖

This pack includes an exclusive decorative prop to personalize your aquarium and make it feel even more like your own little underwater sanctuary. 🌊✨

🌿 Important: This DLC is purely cosmetic — it doesn’t provide any gameplay advantage or pay-to-win elements.
By purchasing it, you’re directly supporting the developer and helping keep this peaceful underwater world alive and growing. 💙
